title: Intambamyi ku nzu ya kera
intro: Muri ico gisagara ceranda, hari umuntu w’inkomezi yarashavuye cane igihe ubutumwa bushasha bwatangura gukwiragira. Uwo muntu, izina ryiwe ryacitse ijambo rimwe ry’ukurwanya ukuri, yarabonye akosho kabo kariko karasenyuka kubera uburemere bw’ivyahishuriwe n’Imana. Uwo mutima yari nde, iherezo ryiwe ryashizweko ikidodo mu musenyi w’ikibanza c’intambara kizwi cane?
clues: Nari umukuru mu bantu banje, nkaba nzwi kubera ubutunzi bwanje be n’ububasha nari mfise mu gisagara carimwo ahantu heranda ha kera.
Igihe umuntu wo mu muryango wanje yatangura kwamamaza ubutumwa bw’Imana imwe, naramutwengeye be n’ivyo yahishuriwe, nkavyita inkuru gusa z’ivya kera.
Narahanganye n’uwo mugabo igihe yariko arasenga hafi y’ico kibanza ceranda, nkamutera ubwoba ko nzohagarika ugusenga kwiwe ku nguvu nimba bikenewe.
Nari mu barongozi bateguye gucecekesha ukwemera gushasha, bakarwanya abayoboke bakwo n’amajambo n’ibirwanisho.
Naciye ngenda n’ingabo tuja ahantu hitwa Badr, nizigiye ko twojanjagura uwo mugwi mutoyi w’abizera.
Ariko kuri iyo ntambara, ubuzima bwanje bwaraheze, urupfu rwanje rwacitse icigwa ku baguma mu kutizera inyuma y’ibimenyetso bigaragara.
verse: Have you seen the one who forbids (96:9)
